responsibility: Provides the PowerPC/RS6000 port’s common target hooks for default optimization policy, option initialization, option decoding, and split-stack capability checks. It sets optimization defaults such as early wide-type splitting, sched-pressure, loop-unrolling policy, and disabled register renaming; initializes ABI-sensitive defaults like errno-math behavior, section anchors, and asynchronous unwind tables; decodes many shared machine options affecting TOC usage, 32/64-bit mode, relocatable code, long-double size, debug masks, and reciprocal-math settings; and reports whether the configured GNU/Linux PowerPC64 environment supports -fsplit-stack. This file is the shared option-state management layer for rs6000 before backend-specific code generation.
